Run programs on a cron

Usage:
  kaab schedules [command]

Available Commands:
  create      Create a schedule
  list        List schedules
  pause       Pause a schedule
  resume      Resume a paused schedule
  runs        List a schedule's runs, newest first

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for schedules

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)

Use "kaab schedules [command] --help" for more information about a command.
